entries.wording: The shipment has been created by the sender, we are waiting for it to be entrusted to us for dispatch to its destination.
entries.note: The sender booked the shipment and has not handed it over. The first scan.

entries.wording: Shipped from sending Depot. In transit.
entries.note: The sending depot dispatched the shipment, its first physical scan.

entries.wording: Shipment in transit.
entries.note: Sorted at a hub between the two depots.

entries.wording: Arrived at final Depot.
entries.note: At the receiving depot, before the delivery round.

entries.wording: The shipment has not yet arrived at the receiving GLS Depot.
entries.note: A delay notice the receiving depot writes while the shipment is still on its way to it; it can repeat on later days.

entries.wording: The shipment did not arrive at the receiving GLS Depot.
entries.note: The receiving depot's first delay notice for a shipment it expected.

entries.wording: Delivery scheduled during the day.
entries.note: The morning scan of the delivery round; the delivery or a failed attempt follows the same day. The rail's step is In delivery.

entries.wording: Available for collection at GLS POINT.
entries.note: Left at a GLS Point for the recipient to collect. The reply does not name the point.

entries.wording: Delivered.
entries.note: Delivered, at the door or collected from a GLS Point. The reply adds the masked name of who took it, which is not read.

entries.wording: Parcel not delivered as the consignee was absent, please book redelivery within 3 working days as per instructions provided by email or sms.
entries.note: A delivery attempt failed because nobody was in. The reply breaks it over three lines.

entries.wording: Not in delivery. Awaiting instructions by link included in received email or sms
entries.note: Held at the depot after a failed attempt until the recipient books a redelivery through the link.

entries.wording: The parcel was handed over to GLS.
entries.note: On a shipment sent on to another GLS country, that country's receipt of it from GLS Italy, after the sending depot's dispatch. It is no acceptance.

entries.wording: The parcel data was entered into the GLS IT system; the parcel was not yet handed over to GLS.
entries.note: The next GLS country's pre-advice of a shipment GLS Italy sends on. Written after the dispatch, it reads as in transit.

entries.wording: Forwarded abroad
entries.note: GLS Italy sent the shipment on to another GLS country.

entries.wording: The parcel has left the parcel center.
entries.note: A depot of the next GLS country dispatched the shipment.

entries.wording: The parcel has reached the parcel center.
entries.note: A depot of the next GLS country received the shipment.

entries.wording: The parcel is expected to be delivered during the day.
entries.note: The next GLS country's morning scan of the delivery round.

entries.wording: Area served in <n> hours, we will deliver within the next two business days.
entries.note: The receiving depot serves the recipient's area only every so many hours, so the shipment waits there for the next round.

entries.wording: Delivery scheduled for first next business day.
entries.note: The receiving depot books the delivery for the next business day, a day after its area notice; the shipment waits there.

entries.wording: La spedizione e' stata creata dal mittente, attendiamo che ci venga affidata per l'invio a destinazione.
entries.english: The shipment has been created by the sender, we are waiting for it to be entrusted to us for dispatch to its destination.
entries.note: The Italian version of the sender's booking, before the hand-over.

entries.wording: Partita dalla sede mittente. In transito.
entries.english: Shipped from sending Depot. In transit.
entries.note: The Italian version of the sending depot's dispatch.

entries.wording: In transito.
entries.note: The Italian version of a hub scan between the two depots.

entries.wording: Arrivata nella Sede GLS locale.
entries.note: The Italian version of the arrival at the receiving depot.

entries.wording: Consegna prevista nel corso della giornata odierna.
entries.note: The Italian version of the morning scan of the delivery round.

entries.wording: Consegnata.
entries.note: The Italian version of the delivery.

entries.wording: Destinatario assente al primo passaggio. Prego prenotare la consegna entro 3 giorni lavorativi, seguendo le istruzioni ricevute via mail o sms.
entries.english: Parcel not delivered as the consignee was absent, please book redelivery within 3 working days as per instructions provided by email or sms.
entries.note: The Italian version of a failed attempt because nobody was in.

entries.wording: Spedizione non in consegna. Il destinatario puo' prenotare la riconsegna tramite link presente in email / sms ricevuto
entries.english: Not in delivery. Awaiting instructions by link included in received email or sms
entries.note: The Italian version of the hold until the recipient books a redelivery.

entries.wording: Consegna prenotata il <date>
entries.note: The day the recipient booked a redelivery for, as dd/mm/yy, after a failed attempt left the parcel awaiting instructions: it waits at the depot, on its way again. Written in Italian in the English locale too; the day is the estimate while it is the newest scan.
A step of the progress rail, labelled Preadvice. Its current step stands in only when the newest scan's sentence gives no stage.
A step of the progress rail, labelled In transit. Its current step stands in only when the newest scan's sentence gives no stage.
A step of the progress rail, labelled Final parcel center. Its current step stands in only when the newest scan's sentence gives no stage.
A step of the progress rail, labelled In delivery. Its current step stands in only when the newest scan's sentence gives no stage.
A step of the progress rail, labelled Delivered. Its current step stands in only when the newest scan's sentence gives no stage.
